title: code-review Agent Result
description: Structured output from the code-review agent (SDLC-HOOK-04). The verdict is a fixed outcome; the post-script counts prior rejections from the issue timeline (SDLC-HOOK-12), not from this result, rejects the result as stale if the reviewed head_sha no longer matches the PR head (SDLC-HOOK-07), and gates an approval on required checks being green.
